external_collaboration.evidence_quote: The University is recognised as the partner of choice for many large corporations including AstraZeneca and Siemens. These partnerships span different disciplines and are governed by framework agreements covering research, recruitment and PhD training.

The University of Manchester Innovation Factory works with academic and student inventors to take their world-changing ideas and technologies and commericalise the University’s diverse portfolio of intellectual property. In 2021 we launched Northern Gritstone, an investment partnership between the Universities of Manchester, Leeds and Sheffield to drive enterprise activities across the North of England.
